systems.name: 7.1 Visual Atmosphere & Art
systems.notes: Create a cohesive visual style: dark fantasy, gothic, atmospheric. Top-down sprites for characters, dungeon tiles, props, and UI elements.
tasks: Character sprites: 4 classes + Mimic forms + Ghost forms
Dungeon tilesets: crypt, catacombs, archives, prison, sanctum
Prop sprites: chests, crates, torches, statues, traps
UI design: HUD, spirit check meter, inventory, Trophy Room

systems.name: 7.2 Sound Design & Atmosphere
systems.notes: Immersive audio is critical for horror. Proximity-based sounds, ambient dungeon audio, and distinct audio cues for Mimic reveals and ghost interactions.
tasks: Ambient dungeon sounds per chapter theme (drips, echoes, creaks)
Proximity audio: footsteps, voices, object interactions
Mimic audio cues: subtle tell when near (heartbeat, whisper)
Ghost audio: ethereal effects, poltergeist sounds
Campfire ambience: crackling fire, night sounds

systems.name: 7.3 Balance & Playtesting
systems.notes: Asymmetric games require extensive playtesting. Balance Mimic power vs party survivability. Ensure social deduction is fair but tense.
tasks: Internal playtesting with 5 players (1 Mimic + 4 Party)
Balance pass: Mimic kill potential vs party detection tools
Spirit Check cost and cooldown tuning
Ghost ability impact: ensure meaningful but not overpowered

systems.name: 7.4 Platform Integration & Distribution
systems.notes: Package for Foundry VTT or as a standalone client. Ensure networking supports 5+ players with proximity chat.
tasks: Foundry VTT module packaging (if targeting VTT)
Server setup for proximity voice (WebRTC or similar)
Distribution: itch.io, Steam page, community Discord
